services.description: List of SSSD services to enable (e.g., nss for name resolution, pam for authentication).

domains.description: List of domain names (each becomes [domain/<name>] section).

ldap_uris.description: LDAP server URIs (space/comma separated). Include ldaps:// for TLS.

search_base.description: Base DN for LDAP user/group searches (e.g., 'ou=people,dc=example,dc=com').

ldap_schema.description: LDAP schema in use: 'rfc2307' (standard POSIX), 'rfc2307bis' (group-of-names), or 'apple_mactelnet'.

default_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for authentication queries (leave empty for anonymous bind).

default_authtok.description: Password for the bind DN. Preferably set via file or environment in production.

tls_ca_cert_dir.description: Path to directory containing CA certificates (for TLS verification). Optional.

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to a specific CA certificate file. Optional.

user_name_attr.description: LDAP attribute to use as the username (e.g., 'uid', 'sAMAccountName').

user_uid_attr.description: LDAP attribute for the user's numeric UID.

user_gid_attr.description: LDAP attribute for the user's primary GID.

user_homedir_attr.description: LDAP attribute for the user's home directory path.

user_shell_attr.description: LDAP attribute for the user's default shell.

group_name_attr.description: LDAP attribute to use as the group name (e.g., 'cn', 'sAMAccountName').

group_gid_attr.description: LDAP attribute for the group's numeric GID.

cache_credentials.description: Enable caching of credentials for offline authentication (e.g., for laptops).

enable_authorization.description: Enable LDAP-based authorization (e.g., for sudo rules or SELinux mapping).

debug_level.description: SSSD internal log verbosity (0–9). Higher values increase log detail.

log_file.description: Path to the main SSSD log file.
